title: The Hilbert-polynomial piece of Quot is proper for proper X with ample L
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file moduli.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Prove Quot^P_{F/X/B} is proper for X -> B proper of finite presentation with L ample: etale-locally take B affine; find a closed immersion i: X -> P^n_B with L^{tensor d} = i^*O(1) (quasi-projective lemma); the twist L -> L^{tensor d}, P(t) -> P(dt) leaves the Quot functor unchanged (the author omits some bookkeeping here - routine polynomial reparametrization, not conclusion-bearing); lemma-quot-closed identifies Quot_{F/X/B} with Quot_{i_*F/P^n_B/B} preserving P-pieces, and the target is proper by lemma-quot-Pn-over-base.
